title: Cannelloni di Ricotta e Spinaci
subtitle: Ricotta and spinach filled pasta tubes in tomato sauce
excerpt: Pasta tubes filled with a creamy ricotta and spinach mixture, arranged in a tomato sauce and baked until the tops are golden. A classic of Italian home cooking, substantial and satisfying.

recipe.sourceNotes: Cannelloni, meaning large tubes in Italian, refers to large pasta cylinders traditionally filled with meat or ricotta and spinach, then baked in a tomato or bechamel sauce. The ricotta and spinach version is the classic vegetarian filling and is widespread throughout Italy. In Italian home cooking, cannelloni are often made from fresh lasagne sheets rolled around the filling rather than pre-formed tubes.

recipeTools.notes: For the filling and the tomato sauce.

content.text: Squeeze every drop of water from the cooked spinach before mixing it into the ricotta. Wet spinach makes the filling loose and watery, which causes the cannelloni to steam rather than bake. A piping bag makes filling the tubes much easier, but a teaspoon and patience work fine. The tomato sauce should be generously seasoned and poured over and around the tubes, not just under them.

Wilt the spinach in a large pan with a splash of water over high heat, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain, cool, and squeeze out all the water. Chop finely. Combine with the ricotta, half the parmesan, the egg, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Mix well. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Make the tomato sauce: heat the olive oil in a pan, add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the tinned tomatoes, a pinch of salt, and the basil. Simmer for 15 minutes until slightly thickened.

Heat the oven to 190 C / fan 170 C / gas 5. Pour half the tomato sauce into the base of the baking dish. Fill each cannelloni tube with the ricotta mixture using a piping bag or teaspoon, and arrange in a single layer. Pour the remaining tomato sauce over the top. Scatter with the remaining parmesan.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10 more minutes until the top is golden and the sauce is bubbling at the edges. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
